audit.whatIsWrong: Void Stone appears nowhere on the page, and content mid calls Null Sphere 'a spellshield'.
audit.why: Void Stone gives Kassadin flat reduced MAGIC damage and unit-collision immunity, and every damaging ability Neeko owns is magic — it is the single most important interaction in this matchup and it was never stated. Null Sphere's shield absorbs magic damage; it does not nullify a spell the way a true spell shield does, so telling a player it is a spellshield changes how they sequence the combo.
audit.corrected: Void Stone written into tldr, tradeGood, cooldowns, itemization and the first-item spike; Null Sphere described as a magic-damage shield.
sources: enemyKit P and Q Riot text

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[3..4].side read 'Skill' and phases[5..6].side read 'Kassadin', while content win[0..6] is Neeko on all seven rows and the packet levelChart is Neeko on all seven.
audit.why: Four rows rendered a different winner in the full layer than in the content layer. The whys under those rows already described Neeko winning, so the sides were the wrong half.
audit.corrected: phases[3..6].side moved to Neeko to match win[N], with every why rewritten to Kassadin-specific grounds in the same proposal.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text was generic and never used a Kassadin number.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s for 40 mana, and repeats in a short window cost extra mana and deal extra damage — the punishable moment is the SECOND blink, not the first. Force Pulse is 21s at rank 1 and charges off spells cast in his vicinity, so your own poke arms his 400-range cone.
audit.corrected: Spikes, cooldowns and trading rewritten around the repeat-Riftwalk cost and the Force Pulse charge mechanic.
sources: enemyKit R and E Riot text and cooldowns

audit.why: Defect 3. Riftwalk 5/3.5/2s, Force Pulse 21/20/19/18/17s, Null Sphere 650 range on 9s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was the tradeGood string verbatim, dontsFull[1].d was the generic clone line, and dontsFull[2].d was the tradeBad string verbatim — none matched their titles.

audit.whatIsWrong: The brief's missingInteractions lists 'Kassadin's Null Sphere (Q) is a channel — your E and R cancel it outright'.
audit.why: That is a derived-flag misfire. Riot's text says Null Sphere deals damage and INTERRUPTS channels; it is not itself a channel. I did not write the claim anywhere.
audit.corrected: Not written. The genuinely open question is the reverse direction — whether Null Sphere's interrupt can cancel Pop Blossom's preparation — and that is not answerable from the kit files.

Worst wave: a frozen wave he farms safely, which is the exact game state Rod of Ages wants. Crash timing: the crash is a timer you set — reset, plate, or a dive on a short wave, but never a shove that just gives him free XP.

notes: Void Stone was absent from the entire page and it is the defining interaction — Neeko deals only magic damage. Itemization now routes to Void Staff instead of Rabadon's for that reason. The brief's missingInteractions entry claiming Null Sphere IS a channel that your E/R cancels is a derived-flag misfire: Riot's text says Null Sphere interrupts channels, it is not one. I did not write it. Chart pairs: phases[3..6].side disagreed with win[N] and the packet levelChart (both Neeko on all seven) — sides moved to Neeko with all seven whys rewritten in the same proposal. Ratings and tone untouched. diff EVEN at 5.5/10 sits low against a 58.65% win rate and a seven-row Neeko chart, but 104 games is a thin sample and Kassadin's scaling genuinely makes the game harder than the lane, so I left the enums alone rather than flip on a hunch.
